basic_info.description: La Dolce VIDA! Enjoy Stunning City Views from this  meticulously maintained, corner 2BED/2BATH condo in the heart of SF. From the formal entry, an open floorplan seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining & living room, all characterized by clean lines, concrete accents & sleek fixtures. The gourmet kitchen features Liebherr & Bosch appliances, European-style cabinetry, quartz countertops and ample storage. Primary suite boasts 2 closets (1 walk-in) and an en-suite bathroom with dual vanity & glass shower enclosure. Ideal for guests or roommates, the 2nd bedroom invites you to enjoy city views and a spacious custom closet. Add'l features include a 2nd guest bathroom, exclusive-use terrace w/ sweeping City views, hardwood floors throughout, custom window treatments, kitchen island and fresh paint. Added conveniences are a full-size W/D, dedicated bike room and 1 car parking. Building amenities incl. an attended lobby, pano view rooftop deck w/BBQ, gym, & communal space. Walker's paradise, 100 Walk Score and 98 Biker's Score.  Centrally located in burgeoning and sunny Mission neighborhood with World Class dining, nightlife and entertainment outside front door. Ideal for commuters with close proximity to shuttles, BART, Muni and 280/101.
